name: Gifts of the Gods of Egypt

pages.text: Khopesh of the pharaoh: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.6, durability 1650, fireproof. Every blow withers the foe for 3 seconds.

Was-sceptre: durability 250. Right-click raises a storm: the foes within 8 blocks are thrown back, blinded and slowed. Every 10 seconds.$(br)Nemes of the Sphinx: armour 3, toughness 2, durability 330. Night Vision.

Pectoral of Ra: armour 8, toughness 2.5, knockback -5%, durability 528, fireproof. Fire Resistance and Strength.$(br)Staff of Ra: durability 400, fireproof. Right-click hurls three fireballs. Every 2 seconds.
Flail of Osiris: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.2, durability 1650. Lifesteal 12%; the undead grow weak and slow.

Sceptre of Isis: durability 250. Right-click heals 6 and gives Regeneration II to you, the players, pets and family within 8 blocks. Every 20 seconds.$(br)Bow of Horus: durability 640. Arrows strike 2.5 harder, and whoever they hit glows for 10 seconds.

Glaive of Anubis: damage 9.5, attack speed 1.0, durability 1650. Monster slaying 15%, its blow slows.$(br)Staff of Thoth: durability 400. Right-click: a word of power up to 24 blocks, 7 magic damage and Levitation. Every 1.5 seconds.

Dagger of Bastet: damage 6.5, attack speed 2.6, durability 1650. Evasion 5%, each blow makes you swift.$(br)Khopesh of Sobek: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.6, durability 1650. Monster slaying 8%, its blow slows and weakens a foe in the water.
Sceptre of Hathor: durability 250. Right-click calms the monsters within 10 blocks. Every 15 seconds.$(br)Axe of Ptah: damage 10.5, attack speed 1.0, durability 1650. In hand: Haste II.
Spear of Sekhmet: damage 9.5, attack speed 1.1, durability 1650, fireproof. Fury 12%, each blow sets the foe on fire for 5 seconds.
Elytra and the wings of Daedalus can go in the back slot (right of the player in the inventory) together with a chestplate: they fly and work just the same.
